ui.「{value}」{value2}读哪个结果？点一个输出口（元件底下的圆点），或: Which result does "{value}"{value2} read? Tap an output (a dot under a part), or the part itself
ui.「{value}」要接到哪里？请点击一个输入口（元件顶部的圆点）或目标元件: Where should "{value}" connect? Tap an input (a dot on top of a part) or the part itself
ui.一关新带来的元件（adds）里加上或拿掉几样: add parts to or take them from what a level brings in (adds)
ui.一段数，用空格隔开: A run of numbers, separated by spaces
ui.两头都是输出口（或都是输入口）：一头接输出，一头接输入。: Both ends are outputs (or both inputs): connect an output to an input.
ui.从上方元件栏选择元件放到板上，再从元件右侧的圆点连线到另一元件左侧的圆点。: Add a part from the row above, then drag from a dot on its right side to a dot on another part’s left side.
ui.修改件的字段，路径为 parts.<件>.<字段>: Edit a part field at parts.<part>.<field>
ui.元件托盘：点击放入空格，或按住拖到指定格子: Parts tray: tap to place in a free slot, or hold and drag onto a slot
ui.关卡里未折叠的元件达到这个数时，从元件最多的菜单起逐个收进二级菜单，直到少于这个: When a level shows at least this many parts, the fullest menus gather them one by one until fewer remain; folded parts always sit in their menus
ui.关卡锁住了这个元件或它里面的内容。: The level locks this part or something it contains.
ui.删除后无法撤销。这一关的其他电路不受影响。: This cannot be undone. The other boards of this level are unaffected.
ui.删除没有被课程、关卡、板或文字引用的件: Delete a part with no course, level, board or text references
ui.去掉件的一个字段或列表项: Remove a part field or list item
ui.在搭出它的关卡中编辑: Edit in the level that builds it
ui.在这一格放置元件: Place a part in this slot
ui.尚未训练。每训练一步，所有可学习的权重都朝误差减小的方向微调一点。: Not trained yet. Each step moves every learnable weight slightly in the direction that reduces the error.
ui.已修改，请重新运行查看结果: Changed: run again to see the result
ui.已选起始行，请点击结束行（包含两端）。: First row selected. Tap the last row; both rows are included.
ui.开放所有关卡、任务、元件和百科。: Open all levels, tasks, parts and encyclopedia entries.
ui.所有关卡、任务、元件和百科均已开放，进度照常记录。清空进度会恢复正常解锁。: All levels, tasks, parts and encyclopedia entries are open. Progress is still recorded. Clearing progress restores normal unlocks.
ui.把「{value}」移到哪一格？请点击目标格子: Where should "{value}" go? Tap a slot
ui.把一关的一块板（参考解、naive 解……）写成蓝图文本: write one of a level’s boards (its reference answer, its naive one…) as blueprint text
ui.按课程顺序读取元件何时到手、临时发放、收起或取代，以及每个升级阶段运行的任务作品: A part’s way through a game’s course (as a changeset would leave it), read off the course, in course order: where it is at hand from the start, where a level brings it in, where a level or one of its tasks gives it there only or withholds it, where a part superseding it arrives, and each step of its upgrade chains (the task whose work runs inside it, with its form). Each event names the level, the task (an index) and the path of the field in the level’s content that says it (null: none).
ui.接到这里的值，就是电路的输出。: The value wired here is the circuit’s output.
ui.板上的元件和连线将全部移除，清空后仍可撤销。: All parts and wires on the board will be removed. You can undo this.
ui.框的区域出现循环嵌套: Frame regions form a containment cycle
ui.框里只能用框开出来的东西和框外的常量: Inside the frame, only what the frame opens and constants from outside can be used
ui.框里还没有接到「结果」上: Nothing inside is wired to the result yet
ui.此处无法使用：框里得出的结果只能在框里使用；要带出框外，请接到框的结论上。: Not available here: what a box derives can be used only inside it; to take it out, wire it to the box’s conclusion.
ui.每行一条：\n 名字 = 类型(输入1, 输入2, …) 放一块:
One statement a line:
  name = type(input1, input2, …)        place a part; its sources in the order of its inputs; _ leaves one open
  name = type[setting=value, …](…)      a part with settings
  name = type(port: source, …)          inputs may also go by port name
  a source is a part’s name, or name.output for one of several outputs
  node <- source                        wire into a node the level gives; node.port <- source for one with several inputs
  box = type(…) { region { … } }        parts inside a frame go in a block per region; what a region gives reads as box.region
  # a comment
Names, types, port names and setting values are ASCII.
ui.清空后，这台设备上已通过的关卡、搭建的电路和获得的元件将全部删除，无法恢复。: Clearing permanently removes the levels passed, the circuits built and the components earned from this device.
ui.点击分区的起始行，再点击结束行。: Tap the first row, then the last row of the block.
ui.点击取下这根连线，再点击其他输入口重新连接: Click to detach this wire, then click another input to reconnect it
ui.点击后再点击另一个元件的输入口，也可以直接拖动连接: Click, then click an input on another part; or drag to it
ui.眼前没有能放这个元件的空格位。: There is no visible slot for this part.
ui.粘贴蓝图，或打开 .txt 文件。导入将替换这块板上的电路，此操作可以撤销。: Paste a blueprint or open a .txt file. Importing replaces the circuit on this board; you can undo it.
ui.蓝图文本（可以带 # blueprint 那一行）: the blueprint text (its # blueprint line may stay)
ui.请先移出要关闭的区域里的元件。: Move the parts out of the regions you want to close first.
ui.这一关不必用到、但可以使用的元件: Parts this level does not need but you may use
ui.这一关的电路和进度都会保存，可以随时返回。: This level’s board and progress are kept; you can return at any time.
ui.这个元件放不进这一格。: This part does not fit in this slot.
ui.这个元件没有能接这根线的口: This part has no port this wire can go to
ui.这个元件的运算写错了: this part’s computation does not parse
ui.这个设置会断开关卡接好的线。: This setting would disconnect a wire placed by the level.
ui.这是这块电路的蓝图：可以复制或存为文件，在任意文本编辑器中修改后再导入。: This is the board’s blueprint: copy it or save it as a file, edit it in any text editor, then import it back.
ui.这样会绕成一个圈：这个元件要等自己算完，才能算自己。: That would make a loop: this part would have to wait for itself to finish.
ui.这根线是关卡接好的，不能改。: This wire came with the level; it cannot be changed.
